question.text: What will be the total retail sales of plant-based meat and seafood in 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the estimated retail sales of plant-based meat and seafood during 2026, according to the [Good Food Institute](https://gfi.org/resource/state-of-the-industry-downloads/)'s 2027 State of the Industry reports.
question.fine_print:
If the Good Food Institute changes their reporting structure, this question will resolve based upon their first official estimate for the year 2026 made during 2027.

If the Good Food Institute does not release a relevant report before 2028 this question will be annulled.

research:
I could not find any 2026 figure yet. GFI publishes its estimate for each year in its State of the Industry reports the following spring, so the 2026 number should arrive around April 2027. The latest value is **$6.6B for 2025**, up 8% in nominal terms.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-04 (2026 reports, covering 2025): GFI estimates global retail sales of plant-based meat and seafood at **$6.6B in 2025**. That is up 8% in nominal terms, 4% after inflation, with volume up about 3%. The data comes from Euromonitor. [Green Queen](https://www.greenqueen.com.hk/gfi-state-of-the-industry-report-2025-2026-plant-based-sales/); [GFI summary](https://gfi.org/pb-summary-2026)
- 2026-11-18: GFI's downloads page still lists only the 2026 reports. There is no data file behind it. I could not read the full PDF because it was too large for the fetch tool, so I could not check whether Euromonitor's figures use fixed or current exchange rates. [GFI downloads](https://gfi.org/resource/state-of-the-industry-downloads/)
- Context from the 2026 reports: total global plant-based retail sales (meat, seafood and dairy alternatives) were $28.9B, up 3%. Europe was $10.1B, Asia-Pacific $9.2B and North America $6.9B. [Green Queen](https://www.greenqueen.com.hk/?p=85119)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. GFI has published no figure for 2026, and the resolving report is expected around April 2027.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-05: Beyond Meat's Q3 2026 revenue was $64.5M, down 8.1%. US retail fell 13.2% to $24.8M, while international retail rose 13.3% to $17.9M. Its Q4 guidance is $54-59M. [Beyond Meat](https://investors.beyondmeat.com/news-releases/news-release-details/beyond-meatr-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results)
- 2026-08: Circana data shows US refrigerated plant-based meat alternative dollar sales down 10.2% year on year in August and down 9.6% in Q2 2026. The number of such items stocked per store fell 10.4%. [210 Analytics/Circana PDF](https://assets.noviams.com/novi-file-uploads/pbfa/resources-toolkits/August_2026_210Analytics_Circana_meat_alternatives.pdf)
- 2026 H1: Quorn's parent reported revenue up 2.2% in constant currency. Sales of Planted's whole-cut steak more than doubled over January to July 2026. These are single companies, not market totals. [Green Queen](https://greenqueen.com.hk/planted-foods-vegan-meat-plant-based-steak-sales-germany/)
- 2026 H1: In the UK, plant-based meat cost about 34% more per kg than animal meat. [Protein Production Technology](https://proteinproductiontechnology.com/post/uk-plant-based-meat-remains-34-pricier-as-dutch-market-reaches-parity)
- 2025 figures released in 2026:
  - US plant-based meat and seafood fell 10% to about $1.0B, with units down 11% (SPINS data).
  - In Germany, plant-based meat in the six-country Circana panel was €750.8M, and total German plant-based sales rose 3.1%.
  - UK plant-based meat fell 7.3% to £295M.
  - [AgFunderNews](https://agfundernews.com/us-alt-meat-slump-continues-but-plant-protein-gains-traction-in-beverages-gfi); [GFI Europe](https://gfieurope.org/press/plant-based-market-germany/)
- I found no 2026 market totals for Europe, Asia or the world as a whole.

## 4. Base rates
Global figures as GFI reported them in each year's report:
- 2015 (or 2014): $2.2B. [GFI blog](https://gfi.org/blog/contextualizing-alternative-protein-progress/)
- 2022: $6.1B. [GFI 2023 outlook](https://gfi.org/blog/2023-outlook-the-state-of-the-plant-based-meat-category/)
- 2023: $6.4B, described as "slight growth". [GFI blog](https://gfi.org/blog/contextualizing-alternative-protein-progress/)
- 2024: $6.1B, up about 4%. [Food Business MEA](https://www.foodbusinessmea.com/alternative-protein-industry-faces-rise-globally-in-2024-the-good-food-institute/)
- 2025: $6.6B, up 8%.

What this pattern shows:
- **Past years get revised.** The 2023 figure was first reported as $6.4B. A year later GFI reported 2024 as $6.1B with 4% growth, which implies 2023 was restated to about $5.9B. Each report's level is not directly comparable with the previous report's.
- **Year-on-year growth stated in the reports has run 0-8%** over 2022-2025. On the $6.6B base, that range would give roughly $6.6-7.1B. But because of the revisions, the 2026 figure could also come in below $6.6B even if growth is positive.
- **The regions diverge.** The US, about 15% of the total, has been falling 7-12% a year. Europe and Asia-Pacific have been driving growth.
- **Seasonality does not apply.** This is an annual figure released once a year.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on this figure. The Kalshi markets supplied with the question cover other things (US and UK retail sales, Loblaw and so on) and are not relevant.
- I found no published GFI or Euromonitor forecast for 2026. Third-party market-research projections use different definitions and are not comparable.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Beyond Meat's Q4 and full-year 2026 results, expected around late February or early March 2027.
- Year-end 2026 releases: SPINS or Circana US data, and GFI Europe's country reports (usually around mid-2027).
- GFI's 2027 State of the Industry reports, expected around April 2027. The 2026 reports came out around 2026-04-21, so the question's 2027-03-31 resolution date may arrive before the report does.
- If the reports use current exchange rates, a weaker or stronger dollar in 2026 would move the figure. I could not confirm which basis Euromonitor uses.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-04 (2026 edition, covering 2025): GFI estimates global retail sales of plant-based meat and seafood at **$6.6B in 2025**, up 8% from 2024 (4% after inflation). Volume rose 3%. The data comes from Euromonitor and is stated in current dollars, including inflation. In 2015 the figure was $2.2B. [GFI summary](https://gfi.org/pb-summary-2026), [Green Queen](https://www.greenqueen.com.hk/gfi-state-of-the-industry-report-2025-2026-plant-based-sales/), [AgFunderNews 2026-04-21](https://agfundernews.com/us-alt-meat-slump-continues-but-plant-protein-gains-traction-in-beverages-gfi)
- The downloads page lists only the 2026 reports. It shows no figures and no data file. The PDF was too large to read directly. [GFI downloads](https://gfi.org/resource/state-of-the-industry-downloads/)
- Timing: the 2026 report came out around April 2026 (PDF stored under /2026/04/, coverage dated 2026-04-21). If the pattern holds, the 2027 report would arrive about April 2027, slightly after the listed resolution date of 2027-03-31.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. GFI publishes no figures during the year. The Euromonitor data for 2026 will not be public until GFI's 2027 report.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-13: The euro fell to about 1.106 USD, near a 19-month low. The average so far in 2026 is about 1.156, compared with roughly 1.13 in 2025. This matters because GFI's figures are in US dollars, so exchange rates affect them. [PoundSterlingLive](https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/history/EUR-usd-2026), [tradingnews](https://www.tradingnews.com/news/euro-slides-11091-lowest-since-may-2025-as-fed-out-hikes-ecb)
- 2026-11-04: Beyond Meat's Q3 revenue was $64.5M, down 8.1%, with volume down 10.9%.
  - US retail: down 13.2%
  - International retail: up 13.3%, its third straight quarter of growth, led by Europe
  - Q4 guidance: $54-59M
  [Morningstar/GlobeNewswire](https://www.morningstar.com/news/globe-newswire/9870771/beyond-meat-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results), [ThePoultrySite](https://www.thepoultrysite.com/news/2026/11/beyond-meats-q3-revenue-falls-8-1)
- 2026-08: Circana data on US refrigerated plant-based meat:
  - August sales: $22.7M over 5 weeks, down 10.2% year on year
  - Q1: down 2.0%; Q2: down 9.6%
  - Frozen: $61.4M in August
  - Items on shelf: down 10.4%
  [210 Analytics/Circana PDF](https://assets.noviams.com/novi-file-uploads/pbfa/resources-toolkits/August_2026_210Analytics_Circana_meat_alternatives.pdf)
- 2026 (period not stated): one trade report says SPINS data shows US plant-based meat and seafood retail sales still down 8% year on year. I could not confirm this. [PLMA](https://plma.com/article/plant-based-meat-alternatives-continue-decline-sales)
- 2026: Planted's whole-cut steak more than doubled its sales in Germany in Jan-Jul. This is one brand, not market data. [Green Queen](https://greenqueen.com.hk/planted-foods-vegan-meat-plant-based-steak-sales-germany/)
- Europe: I could not find category-level data for H1 2026. One search summary mentioned strong H1 2026 results for meat alternatives in Germany and France, but I could not confirm it.
- 2025 context: US plant-based meat and seafood sales fell 10% to $1.0B (SPINS), which is about 15% of the global total. [Supermarket Perimeter](https://www.supermarketperimeter.com/articles/14160-plant-based-industry-faces-ongoing-challenges)

## 4. Base rates
First estimates from each GFI edition. Euromonitor revises earlier years, so the editions do not line up exactly:
- 2023 edition: 2022 = **$6.1B** (+8% in dollars, +5% in weight). [GFI blog](https://gfi.org/blog/2023-outlook-the-state-of-the-plant-based-meat-category/)
- 2024 edition: 2023 = about **$6.4B**. This comes from secondary sources and I could not verify it. [Food Dive](https://www.fooddive.com/news/plant-based-meat-sales-continue-decline-consumers-demand-lower-prices/713891/)
- 2025 edition: 2024 = **$6.1B** (+4%), which implies 2023 was revised down to about $5.9B. [Green Queen](https://www.greenqueen.com.hk/?p=79076)
- 2026 edition: 2025 = **$6.6B** (+8%), which implies 2024 was revised to about $6.1B.
- Taken together, first estimates have stayed between $6.1B and $6.6B from 2022 to 2025. Reported year-on-year growth has been 4% to 8%. Revisions to the previous year have been as large as about 5%, roughly $0.3B.
- For scale: applying the same 4% to 8% growth to $6.6B gives about $6.9B to $7.1B. A flat year, or a downward revision to the 2025 base, would keep the figure near $6.3B to $6.6B. This is arithmetic only, not a forecast.
- Seasonality does not apply here, because the figure is an annual total.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on this question. The Kalshi markets supplied with the question (US and UK retail sales, Loblaw, and others) do not relate to it.
- Commercial research firms project 2026 growth for the global plant-based meat market, some above 20% for Asia. Their definitions differ from GFI's and Euromonitor's, so they are a weak guide. [IMARC](https://www.imarcgroup.com/plant-based-meat-market)
- I found no expert or GFI estimate for 2026.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Late Feb or early Mar 2027: Beyond Meat Q4 and full-year 2026 results.
- Early 2027: GFI US retail data (SPINS) for 2026, and GFI Europe's Circana data for 2026 (2025 data came out in April and June 2026). [GFI Europe](https://gfieurope.org/press/plant-based-market-germany/)
- Rest of 2026: movements in the dollar. The euro's late-2026 weakness slightly reduces the boost from a stronger 2026 average. Weather does not affect this question.
- About April 2027: GFI's 2027 State of the Industry report is the resolution source. It may also revise the $6.6B figure for 2025.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 4.5 months until the GFI 2027 State of the Industry reports, expected around April 2027. That may fall after the question's nominal 2027-03-31 resolution date.

(b) The latest known value is $6.6B global retail sales of plant-based meat and seafood for 2025. GFI published it in April 2026 using Euromonitor data. That was up 8% in nominal terms, 4% after inflation, with volume up about 3%.

(c) If nothing changed, the outcome would be about $6.6B.

(d) If the current trend continued, reported nominal growth of 0-8% gives about $6.6-7.1B. However, 2026 signals are mixed:
- US weakness continues: Circana refrigerated sales are down about 10% and Beyond Meat's US retail is down 13%.
- International sales look modestly positive: Beyond Meat international is up 13%, Quorn is up 2%, and Planted is growing.
- Some of 2025's 8% USD growth probably came from dollar weakness.

My central estimate is about $6.7B.

(e) Historical variation: reported yearly growth has ranged from 0% to 8%. GFI also restates past years by up to about 8%; for example, 2023 was first reported as $6.4B and later implied at about $5.9B. So year-to-year level changes of plus or minus 10% are plausible.

(f) I found no forecasts from experts or markets on this figure. The supplied Kalshi markets cover other things and are not relevant.

(g) Unexpected scenarios:
- **Low:** Euromonitor revises its methodology downward, the dollar strengthens and US and European declines deepen. The figure could then come in around $5.5B.
- **High:** Euromonitor broadens its category definition, Asia-Pacific grows strongly and the dollar weakens further. The figure could then reach about $8B.

(b) Latest known value: $6.6B global retail sales of plant-based meat and seafood in 2025, from GFI's April 2026 report using Euromonitor data. That was up 8% nominal, 4% real, with volume up about 3%.

(c) If nothing changed: about $6.6B.

(d) If the current trend continued: Reported growth has run 0-8% a year, with 2025's 8% probably helped by a weaker dollar. The US, about 15% of the total, is still falling about 10% in 2026, according to Circana and Beyond Meat. Europe and Asia are modestly positive. Nominal growth of 1-5% gives roughly $6.65-6.95B.

(e) Historical variation: Reported year-on-year changes have ranged from 0% to 8%. Past figures also get revised, by up to about -8%: 2023 was first reported at $6.4B and later implied at about $5.9B. Exchange rate effects can add or subtract several percent. One-year uncertainty is therefore about ±8-10%.

(f) Experts and markets: There are no markets and no published GFI or Euromonitor forecast for 2026. Industry commentary points to a flat-to-slightly-growing global market with weakness in the US.

(g) Unexpected scenarios:
- Low: Euromonitor re-bases or revises its methodology downward, the dollar strengthens, and Europe softens. The figure could come in near $5.5-5.8B.
- High: A broader category definition, or a sharply weaker dollar plus strong Asian and European growth, could push it to $7.5-8B.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**

- **High:** Strong growth in Europe and Asia, combined with an upward revision and currency tailwinds, could produce $7.6 billion or more. A broader category definition could push it toward $8 billion.
